'''Donsull''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Quartermaster/Legends|Quartermaster]] of the [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']] and officer of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], Donsull was stationed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] by [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]].<ref name="SWG" />
